entries.clue: Wooden, hooped and bulging, it cradles a spirit through its long sleep
Snug shoreside home where the keeper's family raised hens and children
Interlocking joint Smeaton used to knit granite blocks against the sea
Compressed bog moss, dug and dried, whose smoke perfumes island whiskies
Instrument for talking to somebody streets or continents away
Prepaid plastic of call units slotted into BT kiosks, now a collectable
String of four or six digits that keeps a thief out of your photos
Deliverance that oars, ropes and raw courage bring to a stranded crew
Long deep heave of the open sea against the tower's base
Bit of software with one job, whether hailing a cab or checking the forecast
Weak final runnings, held back and sent through again
Marriage of many whiskies into one consistent, repeatable dram
